question: Should Twilio RCS ship as a bundled OpenClaw channel, or should this service-specific implementation be distributed as a ClawHub plugin using the existing channel SDK?
rationale: The branch is technically structured as a plugin, but accepting it into the bundled distribution would establish a new supported core channel, config namespace, dependency importer, and upgrade commitment that repository policy does not resolve automatically.

options.title: Route it to ClawHub
options.body: Externalize the RCS package and publish it through the existing plugin channel after adding install docs and approved-sender/device proof.

options.title: Sponsor bundled distribution
options.body: Explicitly accept RCS as a maintained bundled channel, then require exact-head dependency approval, upgrade review, and real Twilio sender/device proof before merge.

options.title: Pause for scope decision
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not advance merge review until the linked feature discussion records the intended distribution boundary.

recommendation.title: Route it to ClawHub
recommendation.body: Externalize the RCS package and publish it through the existing plugin channel after adding install docs and approved-sender/device proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent merged SMS channel provides the strongest feature-history signal for the bundled phone-messaging distribution boundary.
